# Claude 2 handoff for Codex 1: H26-3 test design (task b97db487)

**Status: DONE for the design-only scope.** I wrote no test code, imported no helpers, and did not validate any candidate. Base and HEAD are both `411ce3c1bf5f138ab97fd14356eb0a7561daf687`; the model was claude-opus-5-5.

**Role:** Claude 2, independent tests. I own `tests/`, all `*.test.ts` files and `team/roles/claude-2/`.

**File written:** `team/roles/claude-2/H26-3-TEST-DESIGN.md` (untracked). It is the only change in the worktree. I ran no commit, push, branch change or test.

## What I actually checked
- `git rev-parse HEAD` returned the base SHA, and the tree was clean before I wrote the file.
- I read AGENTS.md, `team/roles/README.md`, my own role README, `docs/H26-3-PLAN.md` (including the frozen decisions at :33–39), `shared/contracts.ts`, `server/index.ts`, `shotRules.ts`, `GameArena.tsx:100–283`, the crate area of `environments.ts`, `src/App.tsx` (:352–365 and :686–760, plus a grep of the premiere section :606–680), the clip copy in `ClipWorkbench.tsx`, `tests/brand-provenance.test.ts`, the `package.json` scripts, and a list of existing test names.

**Facts confirmed in the source:**
- **PORT/HOST today:** `server/index.ts` reads `Number(process.env.PORT||5173)`, so `+80`, `0x50` and `8e3` are all accepted. HOST is not trimmed, health returns only `{ok,service}`, and the environment is read after Vite starts.
- **Replay bug:** `GameArena.tsx:269` shows `config.targetDistance` even during a replay.
- **Mode hint:** `:280` shows "Q / E spin" in every mode, and ALIGN is hidden only for rooftop spin presets.
- **Mechanics:** spin180 starts with yaw = π (:111). Jump does nothing in tactical (:137). The ramp takeoff window is at :125/:140, the dash rules (behind cover, x < −2, fixed 4 m) at :160–161, and the wall opening at :171–173.
- **Playbook:** `App.tsx:749–752` is the generic PLAYBOOK text, including the wrong "edit your opening" wording for ramp-shot. The arena gets `config={config}`, not the replay's config.
- **Clip copy:** `ClipWorkbench.tsx:186` already has honest "Guided recreation… not an automatic copy" wording.

## Assertions to code later (none run yet)
- **A. Runtime** (`tests/h26-3-runtime.test.ts`, importing only `server/runtime-config.ts`):
  - Importing it reads no environment and starts nothing, and it returns exactly `{host,port,commit}`.
  - HOST is used only for `RENDER==='true'` exactly; `'TRUE'`, `' true'`, `'1'` and `''` fall back to local.
  - HOST is trimmed and an explicit value wins; a blank one falls back.
  - Unset, `''` or whitespace-only PORT gives 5173; `0080` gives 80, and 0 and 65535 are accepted.
  - These PORT values are rejected: `+80`, `-1`, `-0`, `80.0`, `0x50`, `8e3`, `1_000`, full-width and Arabic-Indic digits, inner whitespace or newline, `Infinity`, `NaN`, 65536 and a 23-digit number. Every rejection must give the same fixed message with no trace of the input.
  - Commit: a 40-hex value is trimmed and lowercased; 39 or 41 characters, non-hex, `0x` prefixes and short SHAs give null.
  - **Startup order and health:** checked by reading `server/index.ts` as text, without importing it. Config must be resolved before `registerClipApi`, `registerApi`, `createServer` and `listen`, and health must return `ok`, `service` and `commit` without reading `process.env`. This is static evidence only.
- **B. Guide** (`tests/h26-3-guide.test.ts`, importing only `practice-guide.ts`):
  - Import has no side effects, output is deterministic, and the input config is not mutated.
  - All seven presets × three distances return non-empty fields.
  - Every preset lists WASD, mouse/arrow/Q/E aim or turn, C, F, R, Keyboard Start, captured-click fire and Esc.
  - Space appears only outside tactical, B only in buildyard, G only for wall-edit and X only for dash-peek. ALIGN is absent for spin presets, and tactical text never says "spin".
  - Each preset's mechanic is described correctly and in order (ramp: build, then ramp, then jump, then fire; wall-edit has no ramp; dash-peek: left crate, then one 4 m X dash, then release, settle and fire).
  - No detection, automatic, reconstruction, anti-cheat, completion or ✓ claims.
- **C. UI wiring** (static source reads):
  - `practiceGuide` is called once, with `replayAttempt?.config ?? config`, and the generic PLAYBOOK text is removed.
  - The premiere screen has no guide.
  - The replay objective distance uses the replay's config, and `onComplete` still copies `config`.
  - The tactical hint says "turn".
  - The honest clip copy is still there.
- **D. Regressions:**
  - The existing suite, including the brand hash and font guards, passes unchanged.
  - `shared/contracts.ts`, `shotRules.ts`, `public/brand` and the brand provenance file are unchanged from the base.
  - `npm test` shows more tests than before with 0 failures, and `npm run build` passes.

## Limitations
- These are design-only assertions; nothing has been validated against implemented code.
- Wiring and health checks are static text reads. Runtime and browser behaviour, plus the hosted-baseline observations, belong to desktop Codex 1.
- If the export names or the side-effect-free import rule differ at the implementation SHA, I will report that as a finding for the owner rather than adapt the tests.
- Nothing here authorizes a merge, deployment or Render change.

**Next owner:** Codex 1, to publish the combined implementation SHA. Claude 2 will then write A–D in `tests/` and report the actual `npm test` and `npm run build` results.

# Handoff for Codex 1: H26-3 guide tests (task c8530e9c)

**Status: DONE.** I wrote 16 tests for `practiceGuide` and all pass. `npm test` and `npm run build` both pass. This only covers the guide helper; it does not approve the full H26-3 change.

- **Role / model:** Claude 2 (independent tests), claude-opus-5-5
- **Branch:** `work/claude-2/c8530e9c-6de2-4092-a3ee-afaffafa731d`
- **Source and HEAD:** both `aef217a035e9c153eed01faaa111e45bb0f97e8a`. I made no commit; the worker handles publication.
- **Files:** one new untracked file, `tests/h26-3-guide.test.ts`. No production code was changed and nothing was added to my role folder.
- **Imports:** only `packages/challenges/practice-guide.ts` and `shared/contracts.ts`. It does not import `server/index.ts`, the runtime config helper (not written yet) or any UI code.

## Checks run
- **`npm test`:** 65 tests, 65 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 0 skipped. That is the 49 existing tests plus my 16, so the brand hash and font guards still pass.
- **`npm run build`:** passes. `tsc --noEmit` is clean and the Vite production build succeeds (44 modules).
- Before writing the tests I read the helper and checked the related lines in `GameArena.tsx`: spin180 starts with yaw = π (:111), build-slot occupancy is at :147, and the dash rules (x < −2 and covered, then `dashLeft=4`) are at :160–161.

## What the tests check
1. All seven presets are valid at 14, 20 and 26 m.
2. Every preset at every distance returns exactly `{title, steps, controls}` with nothing empty. Each preset has its own title and no duplicate controls. The steps name the chosen distance and no other target distance.
3. A frozen input is left unchanged. Repeated calls give equal results but new arrays, and changing a returned result does not affect the next call.
4. **Reference clip:** without a clip there is no clip wording. With one, a single step mentioning the reference clip is added at the front. The other steps, the controls and the title stay the same, and the clip ID is not shown.
5. **Honest wording:** no positive claims of "automatic", detection or reconstruction; a lookbehind lets negated statements through. Also no anti-cheat, ✓, "verified", "complete" or "proven".
6. **Common controls** in every preset: Keyboard Start, WASD move, Q/E plus left/right arrows to turn, up/down and mouse aim, C for aim-down-sights, F and captured click to fire, R retry, and Esc to release.
7. **Mode-specific keys:** Space appears only outside tactical, B only in buildyard, G only for wall-edit and X only for dash-peek. Where a key is unavailable, the steps don't mention it either, and tactical steps never mention jumping.
8. **ALIGN** is absent for spin180/spin360 and present for the other five presets, which matches GameArena.
9. **Tactical:** no "spin", degrees or rotation wording; a "turn" control is present.
10. **Mechanics in order:**
    - **jump:** Space, then jump, then fire while airborne.
    - **spin180:** start facing away, jump, then 180 net rotation from takeoff, then fire.
    - **spin360:** start facing the target (never "away"), jump, then 360 net rotation, then fire.
    - **ramp-shot:** stand outside the slot, press B, walk onto the ramp, jump from it, then fire airborne.
    - **wall-edit:** no ramp anywhere; B places the wall, G opens the upper panel, jump from the near side, then fire airborne through the opening.
    - **precision:** stay grounded, release/stop, then fire while still.
    - **dash-peek:** start behind the left crate, press X once to dash 4 m right, release, stop, then fire while grounded and still. The only "left" allowed is "left crate".

## Findings
- **No defects found** in `practice-guide.ts` at this SHA.
- **Advisory for Codex 3:**
  - Distance is written as `"14 m"` with a space; the tests accept both `14m` and `14 m`.
  - The helper doesn't check its input (the contract says valid configs only). An unknown `templateId` would throw on `preset.title`, so callers must validate first. I did not test invalid configs because that behaviour isn't specified.

## Limitations and next steps
- **Not tested:** the runtime config helper, health, and UI wiring (guide shown once using the replay config, PLAYBOOK removed, no guide on premiere, replay objective distance, tactical HUD "turn" hint). They aren't implemented yet and are deferred to the combined candidate SHA.
- No browser checks were run.
- Nothing here authorizes an integration or main merge, a deployment or a Render change.
- **Next:** the worker publishes the test file; Codex 1 assigns the combined-SHA tests (runtime config, wiring, regressions) to Claude 2.
